title: Harold Law in Cap & Gown, Garden Foliage - Vintage 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: Full-length outdoor portrait of a young man identified as Harold Law on the occasion of his graduation on May 25, 1944. He wears a traditional light-colored academic gown with wide sleeves and a mortarboard cap, his hands folded demurely in front of him. He stands in a leafy garden with dense shrubs and foliage behind him. Captured during the final year of World War II, graduations during this era were frequently tinged with the impending prospect of military service for young male graduates.
